hero.title: Move from Reactive Defense to Proactive Resolution
hero.subtitle: Saras redefines litigation management by handling every stage of the process—from early detection to resolution—with autonomous speed, intelligence, and precision.

features.title: Key Capabilities
features.subtitle: Automate your entire legal workflow from detection to resolution.

items.title: Automated Detection
items.description: Continuously monitor public and private sources to detect new legal notices or litigations the moment they appear.

items.title: Intelligent Drafting
items.description: Analyze case merits, pull relevant precedents, and instantly draft tailored legal responses aligned with your company's stance.

items.title: Centralized Management
items.description: Assign tasks, collaborate with teammates, and track the status of every case in one central, auditable workspace.

detailSection.title: Draft Responses in Minutes, Not Weeks
detailSection.description: Saras analyzes the litigation content, understands the core issue, interprets your business’s position, and drafts a tailored response. This significantly reduces dependency on manual legal review for initial drafting, freeing your legal team to focus on high-level strategy.

cta.title: Never Be Caught Off Guard Again.
cta.subtitle: Equip your legal team with the proactive intelligence to anticipate challenges and manage them efficiently. Turn your legal department from a cost center into a strategic advantage.
